conditional_component_notes.team-drive-option-belt-comet30: Not needed for the current two-motor direct-wheel layout. Consider only after choosing a belt-drive redesign with compatible pulleys/torque-converter hardware, shaft attachment and routing. Required quantities must be reviewed; the two-pack does not establish two installed belts.
conditional_component_notes.team-drive-option-chain-sprocket: Not needed for the current two-motor direct-wheel layout. Consider only if the layout changes to chain drive; determine routing, compatible shafts, ratio and the required kit quantity for both motors before adding to the purchase plan.

custom_parameters.conditional_parts_note: Review these drive alternatives if the layout needs them. They are not installed or included in the current planning subtotal. Confirm compatibility and quantities before selection; a belt and chain are alternative connections unless a reviewed design needs both.
